title: Galleries listing for Aug. 28 | Entertainment | thewesterlysun.com
text:
CLOSE TO HOME
ARTISTS ’ COOPERATIVE GALLERY OF WESTERLY
14 Railroad Ave., Westerly
401-596-2020; westerlyarts.com
Gallery hours: Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday, 1 to 5 p.m.; Friday and Saturday, 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.
• Through August 31: "Shades of Blue"
• Friday, Sept. 5, from 5 to 8 p.m. will be the opening reception for “Imagine Peace," featuring original works by Karen Hayden and Joan Mullins.
Also showcased during the month of September will be the work of artists from drop-in classes taught by Phebe Poppins of the Olean Center of Westerly.
AVONDALE ARTS
95 Watch Hill Road, Westerly
401-315-5479; avondalearts.com
Gallery hours: Tuesday through Saturday, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.; Sunday, 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.
• Through Aug. 29: Summer Palettes, featuring the works of Laura Gaffke, Kathy Johnson, Diana Sartor and Annie Wildey
CHARLESTOWN GALLERY
5000 South County Trail, Charlestown
401-364-0120; charlestowngalleryri.com
Gallery hours: Thursday through Monday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.
• Through Aug. 29: “Maybe it’s Magic," featuring the work of Shawn Kenney and Derek Gores.
• Sept. 6: Opening reception, "As Summer Sets," 5 to 8 p.m.
CHESTER LATHAM GALLERY
108 Main St., Noank
• Through Aug. 31, 1 to 4 p.m., Wednesday through Friday
The 32nd Annual Noank Art Show will showcase works by more than 50 artists, featuring original paintings, photographs, sculptures, prints. A portion of all proceeds will benefit the Noank Historical Society.
HOXIE GALLERY
Westerly Public Library
44 Broad St., Westerly
401-596-2877, ext. 3; westerlylibrary.org
Library hours: Monday through Thursday, 9 a.m. to 8 p.m.; Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.; Saturday, 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.
•Through Aug. 31: Group Show: "Real and Represented" featuring art by Marjorie Ball, Lisa Fatone, Amy Ryan and William Whitehill.
• Opening reception, Wednesday, Sept. 3 for the Community Art Exhibit and Reading. From 6 to 7 p.m., members of Westerly Writer's Group will read short pieces inspired by a piece of art in this exhibit. Refreshments will be served. On view through Sept. 26.
LA GRUA CENTER
32 Water St., Stonington
860-535-2300; lagruacenter.org
Gallery hours: Wednesday, Friday and Sunday from 1 to 4 p.m. Calling ahead recommended at 860-535-2300.
• Sixteenth Annual Stonington Artists Show. Suggested donation $5.
• Exhibit opening, Sept. 12, 5 to 7 p.m.; Echoes in Motion - Contemporary Dialogues from Guadalaljara. An Exhibition by Verónica Ximénez, María Vargas, & Carlos Garrett Suggested donation $5. Exhibit will run through the end of October.
MYSTIC MUSEUM OF ART
9 Water St., Mystic
860-536-7601; mysticmuseumofart.org
Museum hours: Tuesday through Sunday, 11 a.m. to 4 p.m.
• Through Oct. 12: "Gifts of the Ocean (Kutha Makooôkanash)"
MYSTIC SEAPORT MUSEUM
47 Greenmanville Ave., Mystic
888-572-5388; mysticseaport.org
Museum hours: 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. daily
• Ongoing: "Alexis Rockman Oceanus"
• Through April 2026: "Entwined: Freedom, Sovereignty, and the Sea"
• Through February 2026: "Monstrous: Whaling and Its Colossal Impact"
TAPPED APPLE
37 High St., Westerly
401-637-4946; tappedapple.com
Taproom hours: Friday, 4 to 8 p.m.; Saturday, 2 to 8 p.m.; Sunday, 2 to 6 p.m.
• Through Sept. 12: photography exhibit featuring work of Bryn Souza. Ten percent of proceeds will benefit the Jonnycake Center.
WESTERLY ARMORY MUSEUM
8 Dixon St., Westerly
401-596-8554; westerlyarmory.com
Open Mondays and Thursdays from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. or by appointment.
A DRIVE AWAY
THE WILLIAM BENTON MUSEUM OF ART
School of Fine Arts, University of Connecticut, 245 Glennbrook Road, Storrs
860-486-4520; benton@uconn.edu
• Opening reception with light refreshments and cash bar for three new exhibits: Fate and Magic, The Art of Maureen McCabe; Clouds: A Collaboration with Fluid Dynamics; and Encounters with the Collection: Exploring America at 250. Free admission, RSVP appreciated, but not required. To RSVP, visit events.uconn.edu/benton/event/1139324-exhibition-opening-reception.
Exhibits will be on display through Dec. 14.
DEBLOIS GALLERY
134 Aquidneck Ave., Middletown
401-847-9977; debloisgallery.com
Gallery hours: Wednesday through Sunday, 1 to 5 p.m.
• Through Aug. 27: 41st Annual Members' Show and Celebration
FLORENCE GRISWOLD MUSEUM
96 Lyme St., Old Lyme
860-434-5542; florencegriswoldmuseum.org
Museum hours: Tuesday through Sunday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.
• Ongoing: "An American Place: The Art Colony at Old Lyme"
• Through Sept. 14: "Cow Tales"
• Through Sept. 14: "Nancy Friese: Living Landscapes"
GROTON PUBLIC LIBRARY
52 Newtown Road, Groton
• Through October 18: The Colors of Black and White: A Group Show of Photography
On exhibit will be the works of five local amateur photographers: Edward Birch, Jeff Caplan, Eric Cortes, Jeff Kubick, and Paul Lemieux.
HERA GALLERY
10 High St., Wakefield
401-789-1488; heragallery.org
Gallery hours: Wednesday to Friday, 1 to 5 p.m.; Saturday, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.
• Through Aug. 30: "Drifting East," featuring Hera Artist Member Susan G. Sancomb
• Through Aug. 30: "Mapping Memory: shapes of New England" featuring the paintings of Chad Amos Self.
HYGIENIC ART GALLERIES
79-83 Bank St., New London
860-443-8001; hygienic.org
Gallery hours: Thursday through Saturday, noon to 7 p.m.; Sunday, noon to 4 p.m.
• Through Sept. 20: The Crossing Juried Exhibition
LYMAN ALLYN MUSEUM
625 Williams St., New London
860-443-2545
• Through Oct. 19; "David J. Marchi: Break on Through"
• Through Sept. 14; "China from China: Porcelain and Stories of Early American Trade."
NEWPORT ART MUSEUM
76 Bellevue Ave., Newport
401-848-8200; newportartmuseum.org
RISD MUSEUM
224 Benefit St., Providence
401-454-6500, Visit risdmuseum.org for ticket prices and information.
Hours: Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.; Sunday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.; Thursday, noon to 8 p.m.
• Through Dec. 14; "Mountain and Water: Selections from China and Japan"
• Through Dec. 30: "A Changing Reflection: Silver, Metalwork, and Jewelry in the 19th-21st Centuries"
SOUTH COUNTY ART ASSOCIATION
2587 Kingstown Road, Kingston
401-783-2195; southcountyart.org
• Through Sept. 13: "The Great Art Heist"
• Sept. 18 to Oct. 18: "Members Invitational"
• Oct.23 to Nov. 15: "All Media Open Juried"
• Nov. 28 to Dec. 20: Holiday pottery and art sale
THAMES RIVER GALLERY
239 Bank St., New London
860-443-0344; thamesrivergallery.com
Hours: Monday through Friday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m.; Saturday, 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.
• Current exhibition: "Impressionism Then and Now"
WICKFORD ART ASSOCIATION
36 Beach St., North Kingstown
401-294-6840; wickfordart.org
• Through Aug. 31: Creatures Great and Small
